entries.title: Golden pack created (zb-golden/1 skeleton): first characterisation cases
entries.rationale: Runner proof: stop inside a candle (both legacy models pass) and a stop gapped at the open (backtest passes; the engine journal is a recorded known divergence, C13g).

entries.title: AUD-07 cases added with the CORRECTED contract expectations
entries.rationale: Expectations follow the AUD-07 contract draft, not today's legacy output. Legacy behaviour is recorded per adapter as strict-xfail known divergences (observed mismatch lists). When the AUD-07 product fix lands, the divergence entries are removed (expect, and so this manifest, unchanged) and a correction entry is appended.
entries.evidence: branch aud-07-exec-truth on b8c11c8; prototype-fix mutation run flips exactly the matching xfails

entries.title: C11 fixed: time exit after exactly N candles (candle index) in the engine and the backtest
entries.rationale: engine.py cycle() counted elapsed seconds since the fill (exit one candle late when the entry cycle ran slower than the exit cycle) and backtest.py held N + 1 candles (i - i_in >= N). Both now use floor(t/tf) - floor(t_fill/tf) >= N with the fill candle counted, the UI text 'time exit after N candles'. The expect blocks are unchanged; only the known divergences are removed.
entries.evidence: branch aud-07-product (stacked on #32 c055910): G-TIME-L-01 legacy_backtest, G-TIME-L-02 legacy_backtest + legacy_engine XPASS with the fix; reverting the fix re-breaks exactly these

entries.title: C13a fixed: backtest DCA safety orders and pyramid adds pay taker slippage
entries.rationale: backtest.py filled DCA safety orders and pyramid adds at their level with the fee only, while the engine sends them as taker MARKET orders (the replay sim charges slippage on every open). Every exposure-increasing backtest fill now pays px x (1 + side x SLIP), the same model as entries; the slipped price feeds the average, the fee, the notional cap and the add gates. The expect block is unchanged; only the known divergence is removed.
entries.evidence: branch aud-07-product: G-DCA-SLIP-L-01 legacy_backtest XPASS with the fix; reverting the fix re-breaks exactly it
